SELECT 
    100.0 * 
    (SUM(l.LineTotal) - SUM(l.Quantity * p.UnitCost)) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(l.LineTotal), 0) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM 
    sales.Orders AS o
JOIN 
    sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN 
    catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId
WHERE 
    o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025

SELECT w.Name AS WarehouseName, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS decimal(5, 2)) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
WHERE o.Status IN ('Shipped', 'Delivered', 'Returned')
GROUP BY w.Name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActiveCustomers
FROM sales.Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sales.Orders AS o
    WHERE o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
      AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
      AND o.OrderDate >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETDATE())
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerId

SELECT CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2026-04-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-07-01'

WITH July2025Revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
    FROM sales.Orders AS o
    JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
    WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
      AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2025-08-01'
),
July2026Revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
    FROM sales.Orders AS o
    JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
    WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
      AND o.OrderDate >= '2026-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-08-01'
)
SELECT 
    100.0 * (July2026Revenue.Revenue - July2025Revenue.Revenue) / July2025Revenue.Revenue AS RevenueGrowthPct
FROM July2025Revenue, July2026Revenue

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.ListPrice) AS TotalStockValue
FROM inventory.Stock AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductId) AS OutOfStockProducts
FROM inventory.Stock AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId
WHERE s.QuantityOnHand = 0 AND p.IsDiscontinued = 0

SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal + o.ShippingFee) AS OutstandingAmount
FROM sales.OrderLines AS l
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND l.OrderId NOT IN (SELECT OrderId FROM sales.Payments WHERE IsRefund = 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPlaced
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1) AND OrderDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1, 1, 1)

SELECT TOP (5) p.Sku, p.Name, SUM(s.QuantityOnHand) AS UnitsOnHand
FROM catalog.Products AS p
JOIN inventory.Stock AS s ON s.ProductId = p.ProductId
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 0
GROUP BY p.Sku, p.Name
ORDER BY UnitsOnHand ASC
